##
```{r}
centromeres <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz2023.txt',header=T, sep="\t")
centromeres$start <- as.numeric(centromeres$start)
centromeres$stop <-as.numeric(centromeres$stop)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# --- format data ---
bs_plot <- background_selection %>%
  mutate(
    chromosome = sub("^chr", "Chr", as.character(chrom)),
    window_mid = (win_start + win_end) / 2
  )

cent_plot <- centromeres %>%
  mutate(chromosome = as.character(chrom))

# long-like table without tidyr
obs_df <- bs_plot %>%
  transmute(chromosome, window_mid, value = pi_obs_rel, metric = "Observed")

pred_df <- bs_plot %>%
  transmute(chromosome, window_mid, value = pi_pred_rel, metric = "Predicted")

plot_df <- bind_rows(obs_df, pred_df)

# --- plot ---
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = window_mid / 1e6, y = value)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = cent_plot,
    aes(
      xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6,
      xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = subset(plot_df, metric == "Observed"),
    method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = subset(plot_df, metric == "Predicted"),
    method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#5aae61", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df, metric == "Observed"),
    size = 0.8, color = "#053061", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df, metric == "Predicted"),
    size = 0.8, color = "#5aae61", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(pi[rel])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- format data ---
bs_plot <- background_selection %>%
  mutate(
    chromosome = paste0("Chr", sub("^chr", "", as.character(chrom))),  # chr1 -> Chr1
    chr_num = as.integer(sub("^Chr", "", chromosome)),
    window_mid = (win_start + win_end) / 2
  )

cent_plot <- centromeres %>%
  mutate(
    chromosome = paste0("Chr", as.character(chrom)),                    # 1 -> Chr1
    chr_num = as.integer(chrom)
  )

# keep chromosome order Chr1..ChrN
chr_levels <- bs_plot %>%
  distinct(chromosome, chr_num) %>%
  arrange(chr_num) %>%
  pull(chromosome)

bs_plot$chromosome <- factor(bs_plot$chromosome, levels = chr_levels)
cent_plot$chromosome <- factor(cent_plot$chromosome, levels = chr_levels)

# long-like table without tidyr
obs_df <- bs_plot %>%
  transmute(chromosome, window_mid, value = pi_obs_rel, metric = "pi_rel")

pred_df <- bs_plot %>%
  transmute(chromosome, window_mid, value = pi_pred_rel, metric = "pi_predicted")

plot_df <- bind_rows(obs_df, pred_df)

# colors (colorblind-friendly)
col_obs  <- "#053061"  # blue
col_pred <- "#5aae61"  # orange

observed_vs_predited_pi <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = window_mid / 1e6, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = cent_plot,
    aes(
      xmin = (start) / 1e6,
      xmax = (stop) / 1e6,
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("pi_rel" = col_obs, "pi_predicted" = col_pred),
    labels = c("pi_rel" = expression(pi[rel]), "pi_predicted" = expression(pi[predicted])),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(pi[rel]),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = expression(pi[predicted]))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = col_obs),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = col_pred),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/observed_vs_predited_pi.png",
       plot = observed_vs_predited_pi,
       width = 320, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# make sure columns are numeric
background_selection$pi_obs_rel  <- as.numeric(background_selection$pi_obs_rel)
background_selection$pi_pred_rel <- as.numeric(background_selection$pi_pred_rel)

# linear model: observed ~ predicted
fit <- lm(pi_obs_rel ~ pi_pred_rel, data = background_selection)

summary(fit)$r.squared      # R^2
summary(fit)$adj.r.squared  # adjusted R^2
```
